subject: Reasoning
description: Letter-shift codes, position-number coding, mirror coding, word reversal

questions.stem: If 'BREAK' is coded as 'CSFBL' (each letter +1), then 'STONE' is coded as:

options.option_text: TUPOF in the same code system
TUPNF in the same code system
RSNMD in the same code system
TUPOG in the same code system

questions.explanation: Rule: +1 shift. Verify BREAK: B→C, R→S, E→F, A→B, K→L = CSFBL ✓. Apply STONE: S→T, T→U, O→P, N→O, E→F = TUPOF. Distractor TUPNF — N kept as N. Distractor RSNMD = shift −1. Distractor TUPOG — E shifted +2.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: If 'TEACHER' is coded as 'VGCEJGT' (each letter +2), then 'STUDENT' is coded as:
questions.explanation: Rule: +2 shift. STUDENT: S→U, T→V, U→W, D→F, E→G, N→P, T→V = UVWFGPV. Verify TEACHER: T→V, E→G, A→C, C→E, H→J, E→G, R→T = VGCEJGT ✓. Distractor UVWFFPV slips on E. Distractor RSTCDMS = shift −1. Distractor UVWGGPV slips on D.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: In a code, 'PAPER' is written as 'OZODQ'. How is 'PENCIL' written in the same code?
questions.explanation: Rule: −1 shift. PAPER: P→O, A→Z (wraps), P→O, E→D, R→Q = OZODQ ✓. PENCIL: P→O, E→D, N→M, C→B, I→H, L→K = ODMBHK. Distractor ODNBHK = no shift on N. Distractor QFOEJM = +1. Distractor ODMBJK = wrong shift on I.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: If A=1, B=2, ..., Z=26, then the SUM of letter positions in 'GAME' equals:
questions.explanation: G = 7, A = 1, M = 13, E = 5. Sum = 7 + 1 + 13 + 5 = 26. Distractor 25 = subtract one. Distractor 28 = used wrong M position. Distractor 30 = arithmetic slip.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: In a MIRROR code (A↔Z, B↔Y, C↔X, ..., M↔N), the word 'LION' is coded as:
questions.explanation: Mirror: letter at position p maps to position (27 − p). L = 12 → 27−12 = 15 = O. I = 9 → 18 = R. O = 15 → 12 = L. N = 14 → 13 = M. → ORLM. Distractor OPMN = shift −2 not mirror. Distractor ORLN = N kept. Distractor ORML = swap last two.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: If 'PARIS' is coded as 'SIRAP' (word reversal), then 'INDIA' is coded as:
questions.explanation: Rule: reverse the order of letters. PARIS reversed = SIRAP ✓. INDIA reversed: I-N-D-I-A → A-I-D-N-I = AIDNI. Distractor ANIDI = wrong order. Distractor INDIA = no change. Distractor IDIAN = scrambled.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: In a code, 'CAT' = 3+1+20 = 24 and 'DOG' = 4+15+7 = 26 (sum of letter positions). The code for 'BIRD' is:
questions.explanation: Rule: sum of letter positions. BIRD: B = 2, I = 9, R = 18, D = 4. Sum = 2+9+18+4 = 33. Distractor 32 = used B = 1. Distractor 34 = arithmetic slip. Distractor 31 = used R = 17.
